AERIAL LENSFROM PIXELS TO PERSPECTIVE.

BEHIND THE BOXES

A model with an aerial view.

This is the project’s trained YOLOv8s detector, exported for browser inference at 1280 pixels. It recognizes 10 VisDrone classes. It does not track video or control a drone.

64.8%Test precision
57.8%Test mAP50
647Test images

These are class-averaged PyTorch results on a custom VisDrone split, not an official benchmark. Browser conversion and image resizing can change predictions slightly. A confidence score is not a guarantee of correctness.

Pedestrian · People · Bicycle · Car · Van · Truck · Tricycle · Awning-tricycle · Bus · Motor

First detection downloads the model. Browser GPU acceleration is used when available, with a CPU fallback. The original VisDrone validation samples are provided for demonstration. Dataset source · Ultralytics / AGPL-3.0
